title: طلبت دجاجتين فجاءها الذهب.. قصة العروس اليتيمة في عين الدفلى بالجزائر

title: بالأرقام الصادمة.. ثلاث سنوات من الإبادة والمحو الشامل لغزة

title: من مرسيدس إلى فولكسفاغن.. الصين تدفع عمالقة أوروبا إلى الاحتماء بالقيود
body: تواجه صناعة السيارات الأوروبية ضغطا مزدوجا من المنافسة الصينية، مع تراجع مبيعات شركاتها في الصين واتساع حصة العلامات الصينية داخل أوروبا، وهو ما يدفع بروكسل إلى بحث قيود تجارية جديدة.

title: بعد 17 شهرا من الاختباء.. فوهة قمرية ضخمة تظهر في بيانات ناسا

title: نجاح كروي وعائدات متواضعة.. لماذا يتخلف قميص إسبانيا بـ5 أضعاف عن فرنسا وألمانيا؟

title: Pezeshkian and Putin stress strengthening strategic ties between Iran and Russia
body: Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian and Russian President Vladimir Putin stressed the need to maintain and strengthen bilateral and strategic cooperation between Tehran and Moscow during a phone call on Wednesday.

title: Pezeshkian to visit Turkmenistan for CIS, Caspian summits
body: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian will leave for Turkmenistan on October 8 to attend the Council of Heads of State of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) and the Environmental Summit of the Heads of Caspian Sea Littoral States.

title: Pezeshkian says resistance will continue as Iran faces full-scale war
body: Tehran, IRNA – Iran is engaged in a full-scale war but will continue talks while defending the rights and interests of its people from a position of strength, President Masoud Pezeshkian said on Wednesday.

title: Ex-Iran oil minister says his resignation had nothing to do with Trump’s claims
body: Tehran, IRNA – Former Iranian oil minister Mohsen Paknejad has emphasized that his resignation had nothing to do with claims made by US President Donald Trump.

title: Iran seeks to expand technical, engineering cooperation with Afghanistan: Energy minister
body: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Energy Minister Abbas Aliabadi has said that expanding technical and engineering cooperation with Afghanistan is among the main objectives of his visit to Kabul, stressing that the two countries currently enjoy good interactions.

title: Support for Resistance Front will continue until liberation of al-Quds: Iran’s top general
body: Tehran, IRNA - Iran’s top military commander says the Al-Aqsa Flood operation of October 7, 2023 exceeded the Israeli regime's expectations, and that support for the Resistance Front will continue until the liberation of occupied al-Quds.

title: Ghalibaf warns enemy seeks to foment insecurity inside Iran
body: Tehran, IRNA – Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has warned that the enemy has shifted its focus toward fomenting insecurity and violent acts inside Iran after failing to harm the country through military action.

title: Security synergy main focus of SCO anti-terrorism drill: Top IRGC cmdr.
body: Tehran, IRNA – The deputy commander for operations of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Ground Forces says the main focus of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization’s (SCO) joint anti-terrorism exercise is security synergy among member states and confronting extremist activities and violent groups.

title: Iran’s US chemical weapons compliance concerns remain unresolved: Ambassador
body: London, IRNA — Iran’s ambassador and permanent representative to the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) has said Tehran’s concerns over US non-compliance with the Chemical Weapons Convention and its calls for clarification have remained unanswered for more than two decades.

title: In photos: Minab martyrs commemorated in Pakistan

title: Mexico City landmarks lit in Iran’s flag colors to mark Tehran Day
body: Tehran, IRNA – In a symbolic gesture marking Tehran Day, several of Mexico City’s most iconic landmarks, including the Zócalo, the Angel of Independence, and the Cuahtémoc Monument, were illuminated in the colors of Iran’s flag.

title: Pezeshkian: Iran–India cooperation serves their interests, regional peace
body: Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian says that expanding cooperation between Iran and India would not only serve the interests of the two countries but also contribute to regional peace and security.

title: In photos: Tehran census takers record households in Pasdaran in 1986
body: Census takers visit households in Tehran’s Pasteur neighborhood to collect information during the 1986 national population and housing census. The fourth national census, the first conducted after the Islamic Revolution, began simultaneously across Iran on October 8, 1986, and continued through October 22. IRNA’s archival photos show the census being implemented on its first day.

title: Greeks protest Rubio visit, US military presence
body: Tehran, IRNA – Demonstrators in Athens and Thessaloniki have staged anti-war rallies to protest US policies and the expansion of military cooperation between Greece and the United States as US Secretary of State Marco Rubio visited the country.

title: Hakim Nezami Historical School in Iran
body: Built in 1908 in Iran’s northern city of Astara, Hakim Nezami School has been transformed into a specialized museum showcasing the region’s history, culture, and educational heritage. The historic school once welcomed renowned figures, including Nima Yooshij, widely regarded as the father of modern Persian poetry.

title: Diplomat: Russia enjoys close interaction with Iran
body: Bandar Anzali, IRNA – The Consul General of the Russian Federation in Rasht, Sergey Vladimirovich Azarov, says that Moscow and Tehran enjoy constructive interaction in various fields and are seeking to further expand mutual ties.

title: President Pezeshkian urges action to improve public trust
body: Tehran, IRNA — President Masoud Pezeshkian has called for greater focus on solving people’s problems, saying social trust would not have deteriorated to its level if officials had worked to resolve difficulties instead of criticizing others.

title: Enemy made grave miscalculation in seeking Iran’s collapse: IRGC deputy chief
body: Bandar Abbas, IRNA – The enemy made a grave miscalculation by believing that military attacks, sanctions, unrest, and assassination of Iranian officials could create a power vacuum and lead to the collapse of the country within a week, Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Political Deputy Brigadier General Yadollah Javani says.

title: Iran envoy: US attacks damaged 111 petrochemical, pharmaceutical facilities
body: London, IRNA – Iran’s ambassador to the Netherlands and Representative to the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW) has said that US military attacks on Iran’s chemical industries damaged 111 petrochemical and pharmaceutical facilities, disrupting supply chains and affecting the implementation of the Chemical Weapons Convention.

title: Deputy FM stresses developing bilateral ties with India, Japan, Spain
body: Tehran, IRNA — Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs, Kazem Gharibabadi, in his meeting with Indian, Spanish, and Japanese envoys, has highlighted the expansion of relations with these countries.
